question: There is an aqueous solution X, whose pH is 2.6. It represents that the solution is:
solution:
The correct answer is **'__strongly acidic in nature__ '.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The **pH** of a solution **varies from 0 to 14**.
 
• Solutions having a value of** pH ranging from 0 to 7** on the pH scale are termed as **acidic.** 
 
• The value of **pH ranging from 7 to 14** on the pH scale is known as **basic solutions.**
 
• Solutions having a value of** pH equal to 7** on the pH scale are known as **neutral solution**s.
 
• Solutions having a value of** pH equal to or close to 0** are known to be **strongly acidic solutions.** Further, the acidity decreases as the value of pH increases from 0 to 7.
 
• Solutions with a **value of pH equal to or close to 14** are termed **strongly basic solutions.**
